_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for Klaviyo template/flow audit rules. Audit scripts must READ this file rather than inlining rule lists. Adding a new banned phrase requires explicit user approval (commit + review).
_meta.last_updated_reason: Initial extraction from inline Python lists in build_browse_search_templates.py / patch_v9xmem_e1_footer_fix.py. Decoupled from author-of-the-day's hot take.
_meta.review_protocol: Before adding any phrase to banned-* lists, verify against primary data sources (Shopify, Klaviyo). If a brand can substantiate a claim from real data, it is NOT fabricated — do not ban it.

compliance_required_legal._note: ABSOLUTE requirements per NZ ASA Therapeutic & Health Advertising Code 2025 + Unsolicited Electronic Messages Act 2007. Missing any of these is a hard compliance FAIL — flow MUST be paused until fixed.

banned_fear_strict._note: Verbatim banned per CLAUDE.md ASA Code Rule 1(b) — fear-based language. Auto-fail if present.

banned_coupons_strict._note: Bargain Chemist is EDLP (everyday low price) + Price Beat 10% — coupons explicitly out of scope per memory/no-coupon-strategy.md. Auto-fail if present.

banned_liquid_syntax._note: Verified broken in Klaviyo runtime (see klaviyo-template-syntax-verified.md). Auto-fail if present.

creative_choice_value_props._note: MERCHANDISING HOOKS, not compliance requirements. Different emails can lead with different ones. DO NOT flag absence as a defect — that's a creative choice. Only flag if the user EXPLICITLY asks for brand-consistency enforcement.

soft_urgency_judgment_call._note: Soft urgency. Brand bans fear language but these aren't on the literal banned list. FLAG FOR USER JUDGMENT — do NOT auto-classify as fail. The user may have data supporting use (e.g., high cart abandonment justifying a small urgency lift).

specific_claims_require_verification._note: ABSOLUTE rule per CLAUDE.md NO UNVERIFIED FACTS RULE. Specific marketing claims are NOT auto-fabricated. BEFORE flagging, check primary data: Shopify list-customers, Klaviyo Sxnb5T (Placed Order) weekly unique, etc. If the claim is supported by data, it is VERIFIED — do not ban it. If unsupported, the rule already requires user approval.
specific_claims_require_verification.verification_protocol: Query klaviyo_query_metric_aggregates on Sxnb5T (Placed Order) with measurement=unique over a 7-day window. If unique count >= 1000/wk, the claim 'thousands of [Kiwi] customers' is empirically supported.

klaviyo_field_name_map._note: Different metrics use different field name conventions for product attributes. Use the right field for each metric.
